warnings: Sheet 2 of 2, sheet size D; ACTUATOR GROUP SB-12053, model 220B. Detail 1: one required. Detail 4: two required. This sheet describes multiple components, not one solid. No revision visible; B in 220B is part of the model number.
Inches and third-angle projection are explicitly specified; no ASME/ANSI/ISO/DIN standard is explicitly named.
Detail 1: stamp or etch SB-12053 at the indicated end area. Material 4130, heat treat Rockwell C 40–45, make from actuator blank SB-12094. Detail 4: material 4140, Rockwell C 34–39.

HOLD—D030: relief radius callout reads R. without a number. The schema rejects a zero/unknown dimension, so .060 is recorded only as a flagged provisional guess based on half the .12 relief width. It is not an extracted radius and must not drive CAD or manufacturing.

HOLD—H001: actual axial screw-clearance diameter is unspecified. Its diameter field .750 represents the CALLED-OUT SCREW SIZE ONLY, because the schema requires a positive hole diameter. Do not build a .750 clearance hole from this entry. The first counterbore-stage diameter is also missing. The known 1.250-diameter stage extends from stations 2.375 to 3.250. H001 counterbore depth zero means unspecified in this simplified field, not zero depth.

HOLD—H004: actual #10 clearance diameter, counterbore diameter and counterbore depth are unspecified. Its diameter field .190 represents NOMINAL SCREW SIZE ONLY because the schema requires a positive diameter; it is not a clearance-hole dimension. Zero counterbore fields denote missing data. Do not scale the side view to invent dimensions.
Tap callouts specify thread sizes, not tap-drill diameters. The .44 depth is tapped depth; blind drill depth is not separately given.

H002/H003 are opposed radial holes, not parallel-axis holes on one planar XY face. Their axial stations are derived as 2.938 and 10.141 from the left end. No common planar lower-left-referenced coordinates are printed, so instance_positions are empty and position_known is false. Axes lie in A-A; H003 explicitly 180° apart, H002 in line. Do not treat section surface intersections as a planar hole pattern.
Notch axial extent follows the depicted flange land but is not independently specified. Confirm limits and number-10 hole entry surfaces against sheet 1 or the original.

The .501 +.001/-.000 notch and .500 +.000/-.001 block give nominal .001 width clearance and size-only limits .001–.003. Actual assembly positions/fastener seating are not completely specified on this sheet.
D007 nominal OD 2.800 is readable, but the fine tolerance sign is faint. Best interpretation ±.001 is flagged for verification.

Angular numeric values and tolerances are degrees. The schema allows only length-unit labels; inch in those angular entries must not be interpreted literally. Circular angular spacing was not encoded as a linear pattern spacing.
No GD&T frames, datum features, finish requirement, or REF/parenthesized dimensions were found. A-A denotes the section, not a datum.
General tolerances are applied according to printed decimal precision. Derived values are nominal arithmetic checks, not additional independently toleranced requirements.

F002 groups multiple exterior machining cuts; radial hole pairs similarly require separate or patterned CAD operations. Detail 4 is a separate component. Missing hole sizes, relief radius, and some detail limits prevent a production-ready model from this sheet alone.
